about: Where auto_content.py looks for the CLEAN original of a picture it finds in an editor's master, and what each place tells it about provenance. prov: real = Dan's real photos/footage, ai = AI-generated, app = product screens, by-name = decided from the file name (auto_content.NAME_RULES), none = unknown (a physique picture from here escalates). Order is priority: on a tie (same picture in two files) the larger file wins, then the earlier source. by-name-else-real = a build's own asset folder, where every AI file is named as AI (ai_*.mp4).
